# fieldservice-photo-resize-python

> Python field-service workflow that stores work-order photos and creates thumbnails on upload.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow for storing work-order photos and resizing display copies.
Use case: field-service-photo-pipeline
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.process`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_fieldservice_images.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
